Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:




Because they probably have a special (or no) expansion symbol on them,
and it's VEKN policy that "new printing of an old card" still counts as a new
card for purposes of playability in tournaments.

So, the Black Hand printing of Jessica-ADV would be legal in tournaments now,
but the Exchanged version of her would not.
